# Goal: correctness

**Cross-cutting semantic correctness work lands even when it spans multiple conformance categories.**

- **Status**: Active
- **Track**: Supporting track
- **Target**: Fixes and audits that cut across core semantics, error behavior, and host integration.
- **Dependencies**: `compilable`

## Why

Some issues are clearly about correctness but do not fit neatly into a single
goal such as `core-semantics` or `error-model`. They need a home that still
keeps them visible and sortable.

## Success criteria

- Cross-cutting correctness work is visible in one place
- Semantic audits and broad correctness fixes are not orphaned
- Issues that span multiple areas still have a canonical goal
) | 59 | done | medium |
| **1823** | String#normalize(form) evaluates argument before receiver (wrong eval order) | 59 | done | medium |
| **1824** | super used as a value returns the wrong static ValType (local indexing bug) | 59 | done | medium |
| **1826** | OrdinaryToPrimitive treats valueOf/toString returning undefined as method-absent | 59 | done | medium |
| **1827** | BigInt loose-equality loses precision / wrong semantics (== String, == Number) | 60 | done | medium |
| **1828** | Array-like find/findIndex skip holes; map compacts holes (sparse .call receivers) | 61 | done | medium |
| **1829** | marshalTypedArrayArgs byte-masks every element, corrupting non-Uint8Array typed arrays | 59 | done | high |
| **1830** | Well-known-symbol range guard off-by-one excludes Symbol.matchAll (ID 15) | 59 | done | medium |
| **1831** | _validatePropertyDescriptor resets omitted attributes to false on redefine (residual #1334) | 61 | done | medium |
| **1832** | compileNewFunctionExpression captures outer var shadowed by a destructured param | 61 | done | medium |
| **1833** | Implicit subclass constructor forwarder truncates multi-arg super(...) | 61 | done | medium |
| **1835** | C-ABI string/array marshaling reads wrong header offsets (param + return) | 59 | done | high |
| **1836** | Standalone Number<->String conformance gaps (0o/0b, toFixed 1e21, exponential, fractional radix, whitespace, ToNumber) (residual #1335) | 61 | done | high |
| **1837** | Standalone Object.keys/for-in/JSON enumeration is hash-bucket order, not spec order | 60 | done | medium |
| **1838** | Linear backend silently miscompiles try/catch (throw -> unreachable, catch dropped) | 59 | done | medium |
| **1839** | addStringImports late-index shift omits pendingInitBody / nativeStrHelpers / startFuncIdx | 59 | done | medium |
| **1840** | Linker writeLEB128 truncates growing indices; call_indirect/memory rewrite gaps | 59 | done | low |
| **1841** | Element-section flag bitfield: parser/emitter only handle active flag-0 (passive/declarative corrupt) | 59 | done | low |
| **1842** | none heap-type constant collides with any (0x6e); noextern/nofunc missing | 59 | done | low |
| **1843** | R_WASM_TAG_INDEX_LEB mismatch between emitter (11) and reader (10) | 59 | done | low |
| **1844** | IR verify doesn't recurse into nested if/try/loop buffers (return-type gate + SSA holes) (residual #1798) | 59 | done | low |
| **1845** | IR propagate: && / \|\| over-claim BOOL; seedConcrete omits i32/u32 | 59 | done | low |
| **1846** | Minor typeof conformance: i64->'number' in with-bindings; externref->null fallthrough | Backlog | backlog | low |
| **1847** | for-of tentative rollback truncates fctx.locals but does not restore fctx.localMap | 59 | done | low |
| **1850** | Harden the IR verifier into a hard between-pass contract (cross-block dominance + per-backend legality + fail-CI) | 61 | done | high |
| **1864** | JS→WASM should compile on par with TS→WASM (untyped JS loses type info → degraded/broken codegen) | Backlog | backlog | medium |
| **1865** | Native Messaging host: large-message echo emits invalid-JSON frames Chrome rejects (#389) | Backlog | done | high |
| **1866** | JS→WASM standalone: compiled .js host emits undefined `env::__extern_get` import | 60 | done | medium |
| **1868** | Linear backend swallows codegen errors → emits invalid wasm with success:true (Refresh Benchmarks CI crash) | 59 | done | high |
| **1889** | any-value → f64 ToNumber over-rejects valid numeric strings (parseFloat fallback) | Backlog | backlog | low |
| **1917** | One coercion engine — four divergent coercion matrices disagree about lossiness | 61 | ready | high |
| **1918** | Stack-balance strict mode + fixup ratchet — stop silently patching emitter bugs into wrong runtime values | Backlog | backlog | high |
| **1919** | Transactional speculative-compile API — 23 probe/rollback sites leak locals, imports, and types | Backlog | backlog | medium |
| **1920** | One instruction walker — peephole misses catchAll bodies; ≥4 divergent recursive walkers | Backlog | backlog | medium |
| **1921** | Replace the 'Codegen error:' string-prefix compile-failure gate with structured severity | Backlog | backlog | high |
| **1922** | Shared IR traversal/use-collection module — fixes live defect: ordinary while loops demote off the IR path | Backlog | backlog | high |
| **1923** | Meter IR post-claim demotions in the fallback ratchet — build/verify/lower failures are invisible to CI | Backlog | backlog | high |
| **1924** | Instruction-level type rules in the IR verifier — operands, branch-arg types, and resultType validation | Backlog | backlog | high |
| **1927** | One front-end pipeline driver — compileSourceSync/compileMultiSource/compileFilesSource are divergent clones | Backlog | backlog | high |
| **1928** | Source-position remapping for pre-parse rewrites — diagnostics report wrong line numbers | Backlog | backlog | high |
| **1932** | Version the env ABI — no compatibility handshake between compiled binaries and runtime.ts | Backlog | backlog | high |
| **1933** | Runtime multi-instance isolation — module-level mutable state bleeds across instances and retains them forever | Backlog | backlog | high |
| **1935** | Retire the undefined-as-sentinel protocol in runtime.ts — getters returning undefined are misread as absent | Backlog | backlog | medium |
| **1937** | Linear backend: break/continue are never compiled (silent infinite loops); dispatchers need default-arm diagnostics | 61 | done | critical |
| **1938** | Linear backend: number[] stores i32 elements ([1.5] → [1]) and element-assignment evaluates RHS twice | 61 | in-progress | high |
| **1939** | Binary emitter: encodeInstr silently drops unknown ops — add default throw, un-gate validateFuncRefs, add round-trip test | 61 | done | high |
| **1940** | WIT generator: unmappable params are silently dropped — emitted WIT arity disagrees with the core function | Backlog | backlog | medium |
| **1941** | Differential testing of --optimize output — wasm-opt miscompiles currently ship invisibly | 61 | done | critical |
| **1942** | Compile-time regression gate — pass→compile_timeout is excluded from every gate, so compile-perf regressions are invisible | 61 | done | high |
| **1943** | Enforce the documented regression thresholds (10% ratio, 50-per-bucket) in CI — today the hard gate is only net ≥ 0 | Backlog | backlog | high |
| **2089** | silent-fallback telemetry + check-codegen-fallbacks ratchet (Phase 0: instrument the 16 verified sites) | Backlog | ready | critical |
| **2090** | stack-balance self-repair must not invent values — null patch becomes a hard compile error | Backlog | ready | high |
| **2092** | spec-conformance suite: tests/equivalence/spec/ table-driven harness + June probe-corpus migration | Backlog | ready | critical |
| **2093** | issue→probe coverage CI rule: bugfix issues cannot flip to done without a permanent probe/test reference | Backlog | ready | high |
| **2095** | baseline validator: sample the standalone lane and fail rows, not just 50 host pass rows | Backlog | ready | medium |
| **2096** | oracle_version stamping + cross-version diff guard (prerequisite for the #1945 oracle flip) | Backlog | ready | high |
| **2098** | encode flake-classification rules in diff-test262: ct_flake/ct_suspect split + bucket signature hash | Backlog | ready | low |
| **2099** | promote-baseline must re-run (not carry forward) poison-classified rows | Backlog | ready | medium |
| **2103** | shared binding-info analysis — one mutation/capture/declaration-order oracle for all lowerings | Backlog | ready | medium |
| **2108** | coercion drift gate: scripts/check-coercion-sites.mjs — no 9th hand-rolled ToString | Backlog | ready | high |
| **6407** | Array.prototype.<m>.call(receiver, cb) never reads elements of a compiled $Vec / open-object receiver | 61 | done | high |
